method.research_route: Route A: simultaneous two-sided Independent Q-learning; rule-guided Double Q against fixed opponents is a separately reported Route B extension
method.agent_A: opponent-aware tabular Q-learning with schedule-aware state aggregation
method.agent_B: opponent-aware tabular Q-learning with schedule-aware state aggregation
method.reward_alignment: implementation shortfall on actual fills; per-step penalty for schedule deficit; terminal residual penalty applies to unfilled shares in none mode or backstop shares in autonomous mode; the terminal penalty is a learning signal, not economic cost
method.untried_action_bootstrap: only tried actions are included; default autonomous mode has no intraday execution overlay
method.execution_model: synthetic event-driven limit-order book with partial fills, persistent passive orders, queue ahead, seven displayed ask levels, sell-market order flow, TTL expiry, IOC cancellation, and an optional impact-priced market-on-close backstop
method.submission_vs_execution: submitted child quantity is not treated as filled; parent inventory falls only by matched execution quantity
method.deadline_c_integration: a separate exact-time tabular Q head learns no-C, IOC+1, IOC+3, or IOC+6 at any lagging decision step; the regular Q agent learns order placement simultaneously using the resulting shared execution reward

deadline_c_policy.decision_owner: learned SchemeCDecisionPolicy Q head; not a fixed calendar trigger
deadline_c_policy.activation: available at every time step only when remaining inventory exceeds the linear remaining-time target including the current step
deadline_c_policy.state: exact time step, remaining-inventory-to-schedule ratio bin, price-deviation bin, own resting-order state, and previous opponent fill bin

actions.0: no C intervention; ordinary Q-selected action executes
actions.1: raise action floor to IOC and add 1 tick above the ordinary IOC quote
actions.2: raise action floor to IOC and add 3 ticks above the ordinary IOC quote
actions.3: raise action floor to IOC and add 6 ticks above the ordinary IOC quote

deadline_c_policy.learning: the separate C-Q head is updated from the same realized per-step execution reward as the order-placement Q head; exploration uses the run epsilon
deadline_c_policy.terminal_completion: the learned C policy reduces residual through ordinary order-book executions but does not guarantee completion; autonomous mode still uses a separately counted terminal backstop

method.completion_constraint: hard completion by a synthetic market-on-close backstop; Q-learning controls all intraday actions and residual quantity is filled at an impact-stressed average price
method.candidate_best_response: minimum own cost among saved checkpoints against fixed opponent checkpoint
method.claim_boundary: candidate-set responses are not global optima or Nash equilibria
